entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand I bought. It's been nothing but a headache and I want my money back. Now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Could I start with your name and order number, please?
It's Mark Peterson. Order number is VF-8820-C9. And don't give me the runaround, I just want to send it back.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now... I see you purchased the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I handle this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's my preference not to own it anymore! It doesn't work the way I thought it would. I don't need to give you a reason, just process the return.

I understand your frustration, sir. It's just that, given the time that has passed, our return policy can be quite strict. For items worn on the skin, it's often considered too late for a return because of basic hygiene and sanitation protocols.
What?! Are you serious? Too late? Your website said 10 days! I want to speak to your manager right this second! This is an absolute scam! I'll be sure to post about this everywhere!

Sir, please, there's no need for that. Let me review the specific policy attached to your item. One moment... (typing sounds)... Well, sir, I owe you an apology. You are absolutely correct. I was mistaken.
Yeah, I know I am. So what are you going to do about it?
Your VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our 10-day return policy. Since you're at day 41, you are unfortunately outside the window for a full refund. I can approve this return for you immediately.
Oh. Okay. Well, you should have just said that in the first place.

You're right, and I'm sorry for the confusion. I've just processed the return authorization. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Simply pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at a post office.
And I'll get a full refund?
Yes, a full refund to your original payment method. You should see it within 3-5 business days after our warehouse receives the item. Is there anything else I can assist you with, Mark?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
